defects: Adds an extra hypothesis [Fintype σ] not present in the gold statement, unnecessarily restricting the theorem to finite index/variable types

Replaces the gold's [IsAddTorsionFree R] hypothesis with [CharZero R]; these are not equivalent — CharZero only forces torsion-freeness on the image of ℕ (i.e. on multiples of 1), not on arbitrary ring elements, so it is strictly weaker than IsAddTorsionFree. A counterexample ring such as R = ℤ[a]/(2a, a²) is CharZero but not additively torsion-free, and admits distinct power series satisfying the produced hypotheses, so the produced statement is not a valid (or equivalent) formalization of the gold claim
